title: Social Media Management | Vertical Studios
description: We plan, produce and manage social content that keeps your brand in front of the right people, so you're familiar by the time they're ready to buy.

blocks.headline: Familiar before they're ready to buy
blocks.body: We plan, produce and manage content that keeps your brand in front of the right people. So you're already familiar by the time they're ready to buy.

blocks.heading: What we handle
blocks.body: The planning, the production and the day-to-day work of keeping your accounts current.

items.title: A content plan
items.body: What we'll post, where and why. Tied to your goals for the year, not to whatever is trending.

items.title: Content production
items.body: Graphics, photos, short-form video and captions, made by our team in your voice.

items.title: Scheduling and posting
items.body: We publish on the platforms your audience actually uses. You don't have to remember.

items.title: Account care
items.body: We keep your profiles current and watch the comments. You hear about what needs your attention.

items.title: Reporting
items.body: A plain-language look at what's working and what we'll change next.

blocks.heading: How social works with us
blocks.body: A plan first. Then a steady rhythm your audience can count on.
items: Intro call: we learn about your organization, your audience and what you've tried so far.
What winning looks like: awareness, inquiries, event turnout or new donors. We pick the goal before the platform.
The plan: the right platforms, the topics you'll own and a calendar you can see.
Produce and post: apprentices create and publish, a senior lead reviews, and we report back.

blocks.heading: Who runs your accounts
blocks.body:
Alea Fleck is our social media apprentice and a second-year student at Vertical Immersive. She runs social media for our clients, creating and posting content.

A senior marketer sets the plan and reviews the work. Apprentices produce under direct supervision. You get a steady presence. They get real work with real stakes.
blocks.imageAlt: Alea Fleck, Social Media Apprentice at Vertical Studios

items.question: Do we need to be on every platform?
items.answer: No. We pick the platforms your audience actually uses and do those well. That decision is part of the plan.

items.question: Will it sound like us?
items.answer: That's the goal. We learn your voice up front, and you can review content before it goes live.

items.question: What does social media management cost?
items.answer: It depends on scope: how many platforms, how much content and whether video is part of it. Every engagement is custom. [Book a call](/book-a-call) and we'll talk it through.

items.question: Can you film short-form video for our feeds?
items.answer: Yes. Our video team concepts, shoots and edits short-form social cuts. See [video production](/video-production).

blocks.heading: Be the name they already know
blocks.body: Tell us who you want to reach. Gabe will set up a short call to talk it through.
